PVA.name: Poly(vinyl alcohol), alcohol motif
PVA.semantic: Hydrolysed vinyl alcohol repeat. Residual acetate amount and arrangement are sample attributes.

PVAc.name: Poly(vinyl acetate), acetate motif
PVAc.semantic: Unhydrolysed vinyl acetate repeat in partially hydrolysed PVA.

HPAM.name: Polyacrylamide, parent motif of HPAM
HPAM.semantic: Parent repeat only. Supply hydrolysis, charge state, counterion, and ionic medium independently.

AA_anion.name: Deprotonated acrylate motif
AA_anion.semantic: Covalent anion only. Counterion mass is included separately for a specified dry salt.

PAN.name: Polyacrylonitrile
PAN.semantic: Homopolymer repeat. Comonomer composition must be supplied for copolymers.

PVDF.name: Poly(vinylidene fluoride)
PVDF.semantic: Ideal head-to-tail homopolymer repeat. Manufacturing defects are not encoded.

PEO.name: Poly(ethylene oxide)
PEO.semantic: PEG and PEO share this backbone. Separate Mn and end groups are important for PEG oligomers.

PVP.name: Poly(N-vinylpyrrolidone)
PVP.semantic: Homopolymer repeat with stereochemical sequence unspecified.

CMC.name: Cellulose, parent motif of NaCMC
CMC.semantic: 1→4 beta-D-glucopyranosyl backbone, without carboxymethyl groups. Record degree of substitution and counterion separately. Statistical substitution sites are not known.

ALG_M.name: Alginate mannuronate motif
ALG_M.semantic: 1→4 beta-D-mannuronate. No sodium mass or information about M/G diads in embedding.

ALG_G.name: Alginate guluronate motif
ALG_G.semantic: 1→4 alpha-L-guluronate, the C5 epimer of M. No sodium mass or M/G diad information in embedding.
